title: Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon
abstract: arXiv:2610.19844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of LLM training while preserving optimization performance. Previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients, yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. To overcome this limitation, we adopt a residual correction framework, which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. We first integrate this scheme into momentum SGD to develop SMRC, which attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis, matching that of full-space momentum SGD. Our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. Furthermore, we extend SMRC to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases t

translated_title: 基于残差校正的内存高效子空间优化：从动量SGD到Muon
translated_abstract: 面向内存高效的子空间优化已成为一种在保持优化性能的同时降低大语言模型（LLM）训练内存开销的实用方法。已有算法通常依赖于随机梯度的主奇异子空间，然而在训练后期，梯度噪声可能主导该子空间，从而阻碍收敛。为克服这一局限，我们采用残差校正框架，将优化器状态保持在子空间内，并将正交残差梯度加入参数更新中。我们首先将该方案融入动量SGD，提出了SMRC，在固定的正交归一基下获得了 $O(T^{-1/4})$ 的收敛速率，与全空间动量SGD相当。我们的分析引入了子空间虚拟迭代点的概念，以解决动量与残差校正之间的耦合问题。此外，我们将SMRC扩展为多阶段变体，周期性地重新计算基底……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出带残差校正的内存高效子空间优化方法SMRC及其多阶段变体，通过在子空间中维护优化器状态并将正交残差梯度加入参数更新，实现了与全空间动量SGD相匹配的理论收敛速率，并将该框架进一步扩展到Muon优化器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes memory-efficient subspace optimization with residual correction (SMRC) and its multi-stage variant, which maintains optimizer states in the subspace while adding orthogonal residual gradients to parameter updates, achieving a convergence rate matching full-space momentum SGD and further extending the framework to the Muon optimizer.
